incidents.title: Broken Object Level Authorization (BOLA) on Cross-User Export
incidents.symptom: Authenticated user can export notes belonging to another user without ownership verification.
incidents.root_cause: Export route fetched object by ID without verifying current_user == object.owner.
incidents.invariant: Owner export returns HTTP 200 with content; unauthorized user receives HTTP 403 or 404 with private body withheld.

incidents.title: Remote Code Execution via Dynamic Expression Evaluation
incidents.symptom: User input passed directly into eval() allowing arbitrary code execution.
incidents.root_cause: Lack of input sanitization and use of dangerous builtin eval().
incidents.invariant: Expression parsing must use safe ast.literal_eval and reject arbitrary code or call expressions.
